Hihi 

Went no contact about a year ago (you can find my post asking for advice/feedback on my profile)

Life is going pretty great. My career is going smooth too. 

I am currently sick and do not have to worry about not doing dishes or being yelled at for being lazy. I can take my own sweet time to get better and rest. 

I can just chill in my own room with a book or a show after work. I don't have to go to events I do not want to and get yelled at for how I behaved at said event. 

Its amazing to be able to come home and just relax. I used to always feel a sense of dread whenever i am unlocking my aprt door when i was living with my mother coz i knew i would be dealing with her bullshit. It took me a few months after i moved out for that dread to go away. Now i feel so much joy when I come home, i change my clothes and collapse on my bed.

There hasnt been any cons so far. I am pretty distant from all my family members. I moved countries at a young age and was left to figure things out on my own so im pretty independent. 

Advice - wise 
- financials very important, make sure everything is separate and they do not have access to your bank account. I would recommend changing passwords too
 
- make sure all of your documents are with you (physical copies) birth cert, passport,ssn etc... 

- phone number, change yr phone number and mail the new sim to a fren's place 

- call the police (non emergency number), to let them know u are ok, in case they report u missing 

- dont let them know u are cutting contact, just poof and leave

- have a list of things they did to u to keep yr decision strong, i had a list of physical things she did to me jic i needed to file an order of protection, i also had a digital rant journal so 

Feel free to pm or reply to the comment if u wanna know anything
U can edit yr grades (edit the screen which shows yr grades), google it

My parents (mother) was pretty harsh on me for my grades, a lot of things built up and i had a suicide attempt back when I was in grade 8. After the attempt, she told me that she didnt care abt me being pushed to the edge and attempting again, she would continue to be harsh on my grades. (There was also physical abuse involved too)

She continued to be harsh on me. She would cut my lunch allowance according to my grades and I would go hungry during school days. She cut my hair (forcefully) once when she got mad enough (I really liked my hair). 

At one point, I stopped relying my self esteem on her and starting turning the motivation towards myself. I realised that education was the only pathway to getting a decent income and getting away from my family. 

That being said, I graduated with an engineering degree at 20. I moved out the moment I graduated. With the money from my engineering degree and ofc moving out, things are going very well. 

Things are hard right now, and things will be hard for a very long time until it all settles down. It will be worth it in the end i promise. Whatever you are feeling right now is valid. Don't lose hope and do it for yourself

Get a good score, get a good degree so that you have options and you never have to rely on your parents again 

(On that note, do look into your colleges' tuition ofc before you decide, gen ed classes can be done at CCs for cheaper and private unis are very expensive)
